mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, the temperature is 66 degrees with clear skies by the Verona Public Library and a waning crescent moon visible.

The City of Verona remains busy with ongoing engineering reports through AECOM Inc. Also, check out the free tri-shaw bike program at the Senior Center, which offers riders a chance to tour the Military Ridge State Trail, or look into seasonal job opportunities currently available with the recreation department.

Today you can join a class at Insight Wellness for yoga. Tomorrow is a big day for trivia lovers, with sessions at Hop Haus Brewing, Wisconsin Brewing Company, Paddy Mac's, The Mill, and The Bogey Factory.
Regarding local activity, on Thursday, July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in an O W I arrest for a Madison woman who was driving without taillights and on a flat tire.
The flavor of the day is Georgia Peach. The store is currently closed but will open at 10 AM. If you are already looking forward to tomorrow, the flavor will be Chocolate Heath Crunch.
